US Strikes Iran After Ship Attack; Strait of Hormuz Impacted

The United States has conducted a new series of strikes against Iran, reportedly targeting around 140 military sites. These actions follow an incident where Iranian forces allegedly struck a civilian cargo vessel in the Strait of Hormuz. The escalation has led to concerns about the security of this vital shipping lane, with Iran also reportedly closing the strait.
